reviews.text: For new clients, you have to pay a $30 deposit. That was uncalled for, glad that we decided not to move forward.
Been bringing my doggies here for years. Love them
Sam is the absolute best! Not only Sam tho, the entire staff is friendly, accommodating and welcoming. They do such an amazing job on my little boy, wouldn’t take him anywhere else!
Such wonderful, caring groomers. My puppy loves them so much, I can’t take him anywhere else! 🥹 …
Always friendly and easy for walk in nail trimmings. There's always people picking up dogs when I go so they must be popular for other services as well.
Pricey but my dog likes it.
Great cut by Sam! Thank you 🙏🏻 …
Been coming here for months. Jameson loves his haircut every time. Alex is great.
Been here since our little puppy was a puppy. Love it

We have been taking my dog Oreo here for a couple months now and we love how he comes back. The staff is so friendly! Shout out Ashlihan, Oreo loves his groomer. He always comes back looking like a little teddy bear🩷🩷

* a before and after his grooming appointment.

Sophia is absolutely amazing. She delivered exactly what we asked for, shortening our pups feathering while still keeping it natural. She’s talented with scissor cuts and really cares. After trying so many groomers with him looking the exact same, this was such a wonderful experience. Would recommend 10/10.
What an amazing groomer! Yuri did an incredible job on our puppies first true cut. He was taken very good care of and came out looking like a star!

A great experience from beginning to end! Booking online is easy, the front desk staff is friendly and helpful, the bather did a beautiful job with the bath & brush, they finished within 2 hours, and the price was appropriate for the services provided. Above all my dog was HAPPY and prancing around when I arrived to pick him up. Five stars and two paws way up! I will absolutely bring him back to Blue Pooch for future grooming.
Japanese style dog grooming, my dog always comes home looking adorable

Haircuts were fine , they usually do stuff with my dogs hair , both shih tzus , before it was very thoughtful now it was literally a blue rubber band in my female dogs hair and the same cotton ball collar around my black dog

The face of my white dog looks so large compared to the rest of her because I ask for a top knot . Seems like they have gotten lazy. They use to really make my dogs look fresh now it seems rushed and ugly . Wouldn’t take .
Took my 15 year old dog for a grooming and Samuel did a great job! She looks amazing
My dog came out looking happy and clean from her appointment with Yuri. Hand stripping price very reasonable!

Just finished grooming at Blue Pooch with Alexandra and I can’t have higher praise for her and the salon. I have a nervous Maltipoo who shakes out of fear at groomers, I told them ahead of time so they gave me an early morning weekend appointment so there’s less dogs, and then being new to LA I was nervous about trying a new place. But from arrival Alex and the staff were awesome and the haircut looks so amazing and was done in a short period of time. It was very obvious they took their time and were patient with my dog. And it’s by far the best haircut my Maltipoo has gotten for such a good price. Cant recommend this groomer and Alex enough!

The way they handled my dog was unacceptable. I do not recommend bringing your loved ones here.

My small dog was scheduled for a quoted 3-4 hour haircut. They called to tell me he would be ready at 4hrs, but shortly called again to say he’d be ready at 5hrs. In 4hrs, they hadn’t even started on his haircut.

I told them I would be coming to pick him up instead of them continuing his cut into the 5hrs. At pickup, they still charged me for his bath/blowout.

Doro did such an amazing job with my Pomeranian puppy. She is so knowledgeable and patient. I showed her a photo of what I wanted the cut to look like and she was able to perfect it. Thank you so much. I will be coming back in the future!
Only place we go for our dog grooming.  The staff loves Sancho ❤️
BEST GROOMERS AROUND!! Only place we trust with our two pups. Sophia is the best! …
Always a great experience!

Have been going to blue pooch for 8 years now. The team of groomers there are simply the best. My dog always comes out more handsome than before, and special shoutout to Misa for being extra gentle and kind to Charlie everytime.
Sophia is excellent with my dog. She is sweet with Donna and her cut is always perfect. She listens to what we want and always delivers
Great grooming but pricey
